items.title: Why Intel’s $20 Billion Stock Offering Is Actually a Great Sign for the Company
items.summary: Shares of  Intel  have been under pressure this week since the chip maker announced a $20 billion stock offering.  UBS analyst Timothy Arcuri wrote Wednesday that Intel’s $20 billion stock offering will “remove an overhang” for the stock as it will allow the chip maker to fund its foundry buildout.  The stock offering will provide “bridge” funding through 2027 and 2028 for Intel, Arcuri wrote.
